1983-11-26: UCLA Bruins beat Long Beach State 65–59. Fields led the winners with 13 points. Verberckt had 15 for Long Beach State.
1985-12-07: Behind Miller's 28 points, UCLA Bruins rolled past Long Beach State 84–64. Wiley, Morlon had 16 for Long Beach State.
1987-12-26: Ohio State Buckeyes got past Long Beach State 93–86 as Perry Carter scored a team-high 22. Morlon Wiley had 30 for Long Beach State.
